ruling.recommended_action: Refund SGD 6.83 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexempted 4.84 km deviation (RD-2, RydeTAXI metered fare); no account flag (RD-6 threshold not met).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 10:09–10:16 (4.84 km extra). RD-5: driver requested the Prince George's Park route change at 10:06 and the rider agreed at 10:06 [F7][F8], i.e. before the segment start, and the agreed route matches the segment's off-route track; the LTA breakdown incident on the optimal route [F12] further supports a reasonable cause under RD-4(a). Exempt → no_action for this segment.
Residual 5.0 km (total actual-vs-optimal) − 4.84 km (exempt segment) = 0.16 km, within the ≤0.25 km map-matching noise tolerance under RD-2; not refundable and recorded as RD-1 review material only.

rejected_claims.reason: Billed excess $7.03 (5.0 km × $1.41) overstated: 4.84 km of the excess sits on the RD-5-exempted, rider-agreed segment and 0.16 km is matching residual, so only the unexempted metered-distance difference (SGD 6.83) is refundable under RD-2.

Driver statement of a breakdown route change is not adopted as the basis for exemption; the RD-5 pre-agreement already exempts the segment, and the RD-4(b) speed bands (band 5 / band 4) do not independently qualify.
